intro: Compare training options, costs and goals, and recommend a route with a realistic condition.

frases.estudio: Kveldskurset koster 4 200 kroner og møtes på campus hver torsdag i tre måneder. Nettkurset koster 3 600 kroner og har ukentlige oppgaver, men ingen faste undervisningstider. Begge gir et kursbevis. Leila jobber turnus og trenger fleksibilitet. På sikt vil hun lære å lage rapporter på jobb.
frases.alumno: The evening course costs 4 200 kroner and meets on campus every Thursday for three months. The online course costs 3 600 kroner and has weekly assignments, but no classes at fixed times. Both give a certificate. Leila works shifts and needs flexibility. In the long term she wants to learn to write reports at work.

texto: **Kunne** introduces a hypothetical option politely: **Jeg kunne tenke meg å ta kurset på deltid** («I could imagine taking the course part-time»). Compare with **mens** («while») or **derimot** («however») and explain the condition that must be met: **Hvis arbeidsgiveren støtter planen…** («If the employer supports the plan…»).

pregunta.texto: Which option best suits Leila's need for flexibility?

opciones.texto: The online course, which has no fixed class times
opciones.explicacion: It has no fixed times, so it offers more flexibility.

opciones.texto: The evening course, which meets every Thursday
opciones.explicacion: It has a fixed weekly schedule.
The text says both give a certificate.

pregunta.texto: Recommend one of two training options for a person with a specific schedule. Include a condition and a long-term goal.

textos: Jeg anbefaler nettkurset fordi Leila jobber turnus. Hvis hun får støtte fra arbeidsgiveren, kan hun begynne i januar. På sikt kan hun bruke ferdighetene til å lage rapporter.

piezas.explicacion: Model: link facts, condition and goal; another recommendation is valid if you justify it.
